release_title: TrajKV Round7: 1.295-bit visual KV, new-source confirmation and static-policy equivalence
release_body: Two RTX3090 workers completed real packed E2E experiments. Primary frozen confirmation: 128 project-fresh Doc sources / 412 questions and 128 Text sources / 128 questions, nine methods. The ~1.295-bit visual-KV point saves ~28% versus the ~1.8-bit incumbent with Doc/Text score losses of 0.464/1.406 pp; the Native4 0.5pp quality target is not established. The conditional policy has an exact initial-static-batch alias, so feedback re-estimation has no independent demonstrated gain. Includes second-backbone first-question evidence, quiet fixed-output costs, all safe results, failed runs and immutable source identities. Exact archive bytes and LF Git bodies are indexed separately. Read the report for complete scope.
